caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a tall, decorative backrest. The chair is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The wood of the chair is brown with a polished finish, displaying a natural wood grain. The backrest is vertically oriented, featuring curved and cut-out decorative patterns at the top and center, and is capped with a rounded crest. The arms of the chair are slightly curved and connect to turned, spindle-like front legs and vertical back legs. The seat is cushioned with light gray or greenish fabric, appearing padded and contrasting with the wood. The legs are connected at the base with plain wooden stretchers. The background is solid off-white or cream, and the drawing is signed "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" below the chair.
title: Pa. German Arm Chair
